title: Balancing Independent and Collaborative Service
summary: We study a two-type server queueing system where flexible Type-I servers, upon their initial interaction with jobs, decide in real time whether to process them independently or in collaboration with dedicated Type-II servers. Independent processing begins immediately, as does collaborative service if a Type-II server is available. Otherwise, the job and its paired Type-I server wait in queue for collaboration.
